tagline.en: Brownsville to Manitoba, straight up the middle
tagline.zh: 自布朗斯维尔笔直北上马尼托巴

start.en: The Veterans International Bridge at the Mexican border in Brownsville, Texas
start.zh: 得克萨斯州布朗斯维尔，墨西哥边境的老兵国际大桥

end.en: The Canadian border north of Westhope, North Dakota, where it continues as Manitoba Highway 83
end.zh: 北达科他州韦斯特霍普以北的加拿大边境，对侧接马尼托巴 83 号公路

en: US 83 runs from the Rio Grande to the Canadian border almost without deviating from a north–south line, which is unusual for a route of its length. Nearly half of it is in Texas. It starts at a border bridge in Brownsville, follows the Rio Grande upstream through the Lower Rio Grande Valley — where, confusingly, it is signed east–west — turns inland at Laredo and climbs through the brush country to the Edwards Plateau, Abilene and the Panhandle.

North of Texas it is a High Plains road and little else: Liberal and Garden City in Kansas, the Nebraska Sandhills and North Platte, then the Pine Ridge and the Missouri River country of South Dakota by way of Murdo and Pierre. In North Dakota it runs up through Bismarck and Minot — where it is the city's main street, Broadway — past Minot Air Force Base, and ends at a two-lane border station north of Westhope. On the far side, Manitoba Highway 83 continues north to Swan River.
zh: US 83 自格兰德河一路通往加拿大边境，几乎不偏离一条南北直线，这对一条如此长度的路线而言颇不寻常。其中近一半里程在得克萨斯州。它起于布朗斯维尔的一座界桥，沿格兰德河上溯穿过下格兰德河谷——在那里它却被标示为东西向，颇令人困惑——在拉雷多转向内陆，穿灌丛地带爬上爱德华兹高原，经阿比林进入锅柄地带。
出得州后，它基本只是一条高平原公路：堪萨斯的利伯勒尔与加登城、内布拉斯加沙丘地与北普拉特，随后是南达科他的派恩里奇与密苏里河一带，途经默多与皮尔。在北达科他，它北上穿过俾斯麦与迈诺特——在迈诺特它就是该市的主街百老汇大道——经过迈诺特空军基地，最终止于韦斯特霍普以北一处双车道的边境站。界河对侧，马尼托巴 83 号公路继续北行至斯旺里弗。

en: US 83 started small. The 1926 system gave the number to a short route between Bismarck, North Dakota, and Pierre, South Dakota — about a hundred and seventy miles. By 1930 it had been extended north from Bismarck to the Canadian line and south through Texas to the Mexican border at Brownsville, turning a regional connector into an international trunk route in a single step. It was commissioned over the whole distance before it was signed over the whole distance.

Its new status as a trunk route brought branches. Three three-digit routes were numbered from it — US 183, US 283 and US 383 — and the first two grew long enough to outlast the connection. When US 183 and US 283 were taken out of the town of Junction, Texas, in 1952, they lost their last physical junction with their parent. US 383 was cut back to the Kansas state line in 1960 and decommissioned altogether when AASHTO approved Kansas's request in 1979.
zh: US 83 起初很短。1926 年的系统把这个号码给了北达科他州俾斯麦与南达科他州皮尔之间的一段短路线，约一百七十英里。到 1930 年，它已自俾斯麦北延至加拿大边界，并南穿得克萨斯抵达布朗斯维尔的墨西哥边境，一步之间就从区域联络线变成了国际干线。它是先在全长范围内获得编号，之后才在全长范围内竖起标志的。
成为干线后，它有了分支。有三条三位数路线以它为母号——US 183、US 283 与 US 383——其中前两条长到足以比这层关系活得更久。1952 年 US 183 与 US 283 被移出得克萨斯州朱恩克申镇后，它们与母号的最后一处实际交叉也随之消失。US 383 于 1960 年被收回至堪萨斯州界，1979 年 AASHTO 批准堪萨斯州的申请后彻底撤销。

why.en: No figure exists. US 83 was numbered in 1926 over roads the states had already built and extended to both borders around 1930 over more of the same; no agency has costed it as one work.
why.zh: 没有这样的数据。US 83 于 1926 年沿各州已建成的道路编号，约 1930 年向两国边境的延伸同样如此；从未有任何机构把它作为单一工程核算。

why.en: Published figures disagree and none is currently authoritative. AASHTO's 1989 log gave 1,907 miles; adding up that log's own state subtotals yields about 1,894; an independent measurement in 2010 produced 1,882.2; and current compilations give 1,885 or 1,886. AASHTO leaves U.S. Route mileage to the states and has published no national log since 1989.
why.zh: 各方公布的数字互不一致，且目前没有一个具有权威性。AASHTO 1989 年里程表列为 1,907 英里；把该表自身的各州分项相加约得 1,894 英里；2010 年的一次独立测量得出 1,882.2 英里；当前的各种汇编则给出 1,885 或 1,886 英里。AASHTO 把美国国道里程交由各州统计，1989 年后未再发布全国里程表。

value.en: 893.1 miles, the longest single-state mileage of any current U.S. Route, with the route's midpoint near Liberal, Kansas; the figure published for the Texas highway itself is 906.5 miles
value.zh: 893.1 英里，为现有美国国道中单一州内里程最长者，全线中点在堪萨斯州利伯勒尔附近；而按得州公路本身公布的数字为 906.5 英里

figures.source: usends.com endpoint survey of US 83, with the Texas figure as published for the state highway by TxDOT

why.en: Six state agencies count their own segments. US 83 is an urban freeway through McAllen and a two-lane road for hundreds of miles across the High Plains; no combined figure is published.
why.zh: 6 个州的机构各自统计本州路段。US 83 在麦卡伦是城市高速路，而在高平原上则有数百英里的双车道；并无合并数字发布。

label.en: Direction signing in the Rio Grande Valley
label.zh: 格兰德河谷段的方向标示

value.en: US 83 is signed north–south at Brownsville but east–west from Harlingen to the Hidalgo–Starr county line, a practice that predates the designation of I-2 along the same freeway
value.zh: US 83 在布朗斯维尔按南北向标示，但自哈灵根至伊达尔戈—斯塔尔县界改按东西向标示；这一做法早于 I-2 沿同一段高速公路的编号

why.en: Condition data are reported to the Federal Highway Administration by state and functional class rather than by U.S. Route number, so no route-level rating exists for US 83.
why.zh: 路况数据按州与功能等级、而非按美国国道编号上报联邦公路管理局，因此不存在针对 US 83 的全线评级。

timeline.en: US 83 is created as a short route between Bismarck, North Dakota, and Pierre, South Dakota.
timeline.zh: US 83 设立，最初是北达科他州俾斯麦至南达科他州皮尔之间的一段短路线。

timeline.en: The route is extended north to the Canadian border and south through Texas to Brownsville.
timeline.zh: 本路线北延至加拿大边境，南穿得克萨斯至布朗斯维尔。

timeline.en: US 183 and US 283 are removed from Junction, Texas, and lose their last junction with their parent route.
timeline.zh: US 183 与 US 283 被移出得克萨斯州朱恩克申镇，与母号的最后一处交叉由此消失。

timeline.en: AASHTO approves Kansas's request to decommission US 383, the last of the route's three branches.
timeline.zh: AASHTO 批准堪萨斯州撤销 US 383 的申请，这是本路线三条分支中的最后一条。
